summary: @ornikar/jest-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a Jest preset but its package.json preinstall runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscated loader (identifiers like `_0x488df8`) that, when `bun` is not on PATH, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a shipped 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (`math_init.js`, starting with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and using a numeric string-array plus rotation decoder). Fetching a second language runtime at preinstall specifically to execute a large opaque sibling bundle unrelated to Jest configuration is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that evades Node-based scanning. Installing this package auto-executes attacker-controlled bundled code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
